references.text: Moses and Aaron mustered the congregation of Israel according to their clans and ancestral houses, just as they did with the sons of Kohath here.
The clans of the Kohathites are listed, and their duty was to take care of the sanctuary.
God's command to count the sons of Kohath by their clans and ancestral houses, which is now being carried out.
The specific task of the Kohathites in carrying the holy items after Aaron and his sons had packed them.
Summary of the counting of the Levites, including the Kohathites, performed by Moses and Aaron.
The sons of Levi and the descendants of Kohath are mentioned in the genealogy.
The clans of the Levites, including the Kohathites, were counted again on a later occasion.
